_comment: Starting village (BUILD_PLAN §8 phase 3; text verbatim from Docs/03_MECHANICS.md). starting_items is writing-gated and empty until the Act One writing list lands.
epigraph: Rebuilt six times. Residents are deeply committed.
pro_text: Starts with hidden emergency crafting cache. First time a crafted item fails, resources are not consumed.
con_text: Reduced effectiveness of NPC assistance early game. Again residents are too self-reliant to ask for or offer help naturally.
mechanics_note: No pro/con mechanic is implemented - this file is selection-screen text and starting state only. The effects described are design commitments from Docs/03_MECHANICS.md, each owned by the phase that builds its system.
